title: First Goetheanum burned as a rival to Nazism

tellings.quote: Oh, they burned down the Gothna. the Nazis burned down the first Gothan because they thought that anthroposphe could really become a rival to Nazism

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells about the first Goetheanum, the headquarters building in Dornach, Switzerland, of anthroposophy, a spiritual movement founded by Rudolf Steiner, which burned down in the 1920s. Jorjani says the Nazis burned it because they thought anthroposophy could become a real rival to Nazism. If true, it would show how seriously the Nazis took competing spiritual movements.
